# Uniix Studio

> Uniix Studio is a creative digital agency in Colombo, Sri Lanka offering brand identity design, web development, and digital marketing services for businesses in Sri Lanka, Australia, and the UK.

Name: Uniix Studio
Type: Creative Digital Agency
Founded: 2022
Location: Colombo, Sri Lanka
Website: [https://www.uniixstudio.com](https://www.uniixstudio.com)
Email: [hey@uniixstudio.com](mailto:hey@uniixstudio.com)
Phone: +94 74 0555 898
Areas served: Sri Lanka, Australia, United Kingdom

## Summary

Uniix Studio is an independent creative digital agency working with ambitious companies on brand identity, web design and development, and growth marketing. Senior team, no middlemen, transparent pricing. 50+ projects shipped, 3× average traffic lift in the 90 days post-launch, 92% client retention.

## Featured case studies

- [Bilesma Natural](https://www.uniixstudio.com/portfolio/bilesma-natural/): Cosmetic packaging design for a Sri Lankan Ayurvedic skin and hair care brand: botanical carry bag redesign, X-banner, bookmarks and logo animation.
- [Bilesma Natural Social](https://www.uniixstudio.com/portfolio/bilesma-natural-social-media/): Social media creatives for a Sri Lankan Ayurvedic beauty brand: nine-zone post template, logo placement rules and five bilingual post formats.
- [St Luke's Medical Laboratory](https://www.uniixstudio.com/portfolio/st-lukes-medilab/): Web Design, Development, SEO for a Ja-Ela diagnostic lab.
- [Wasana Drivers](https://www.uniixstudio.com/portfolio/): Mobile-first booking website for a Sri Lankan transport service.
- [Zerro](https://www.uniixstudio.com/portfolio/): Brand identity for a launch-stage tech company.
- [Coventry Business Club](https://www.uniixstudio.com/portfolio/): Corporate website for a UK business community.
- [Terraflow](https://www.uniixstudio.com/portfolio/): Identity for an environmental tech startup.
